integrity: The all-size claims follow from an explicit finite-poset proof and standard Jankov--de Jongh preservation; exhaustive finite tests are supplementary. No external or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for finite rooted forks with added top and their topless finite powers, not arbitrary finite rooted generators. Fork-quotient capacity is existential over powers and generated subframes; no direct formula-length bound is asserted. General older p-morphism results may subsume the obstruction.
title: Sharp fork quotients and a consecutive hierarchy of generalized Medvedev logics
